root_cause: Three migration identities recorded as applied in the production Supabase schema_migrations table were absent from main supabase/migrations; one additional local-only version remains intentionally recorded, not represented as applied.
change: Mirror only the three already applied SQL texts exactly from Supabase schema_migrations.statements[1], retaining their recorded timestamp/version/name and MD5; never write to production migration history.
prevention: Before claiming a migration-history recovery, compare exact remote+local version sets and SQL digests; a name match, artificial empty SQL, or unchecked history repair is forbidden.

evidence.source: Supabase supabase_migrations.schema_migrations; live PostgreSQL read only

outcome: Exact source restoration candidate only; no production SQL executed.
